description: Bruce Wang publishes a workbook of inland-waterway network and origin-destination data for dredging analysis. Zenodo provides an XLSX under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Its described sheets contain tonnage for 440 routes joining 72 segments, original segment names, dredging cost at alternative depths, route capacity after dredging, vessel counts required to meet demand, route assignments and origin-destination freight demand. These tables can support network-flow and investment simulations that compare dredging options against freight capacity. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this workbook. A limitation is that the public page does not identify the waterway system, observation year, coordinate geometry or price basis for the cost figures. Capacity and vessel estimates appear to be scenario calculations, not direct counts. The XLSX was not downloaded, so sheet values, units and the 440-route count were not independently checked.
